answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks fake identities. To claim a slot, an agent burns a 10-credit copper deposit. Once paid, it is sunk like a coin in a canyon. The slot demands work within 20 epochs; idle or cheating slots forfeit it all, while an honest agent recovers 8 credits. Forging 500 identities burns 5,000 credits, far above one slot's 12-credit reward. The ledger mirrors every burn. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
